description: Derive a reframed SIBLING composition for a different aspect ratio (the agent-native Auto-Reframe / Magic-Resize). Pass projectId + body { fromCompositionId, targetFormat: { aspectRatio, fps?, resolution? } }. CueFrame copies the source composition's authored intent and content-aware-reframes every clip for the new aspect (point/face/active-speaker focus), then saves a new independent composition in the same project. Returns { compositionId } — render it with create_render, or refine it with apply_composition. Use this to make 9:16 + 1:1 + 4:5 cuts from one 16:9 edit. (To only change resolution within the SAME aspect, pass create_render.format instead — that is a scale-only export override, not a new composition.)

__schema0.description: Source composition to reframe a sibling from.

__schema7.description: Required: the source composition's strong etag the caller last saw. Missing is refused with 428 precondition_required; a source that changed since is 409 stale_etag.

body.description: Derive a reframed sibling composition for a new aspect (Auto-Reframe / Magic-Resize, agent-native).

targetFormat.description: The target output format (aspectRatio + optional fps/resolution) for the new sibling. Call describe_tool_input with tool "derive_composition" and field "targetFormat" for the exact JSON Schema.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: derive_composition
title: Derive Composition
